tasks.title: Task
tasks.shared: Shared with people who can edit this chapter.
tasks.private: Only you can see these tasks, including tasks linked to shared work.
tasks.sharedWork: Everyone who can edit this work sees these tasks. Hand one to a co-author, or leave it unassigned for whoever gets there first.
tasks.emptyMine: Nothing is assigned to you here.
tasks.emptyUnassigned: Nothing is waiting for a taker.
tasks.advisory: These checks are a guide. Unfinished tasks do not prevent publication.
tasks.defaultsHelp: Choose the checks to add to future chapter checklists. Disable checks that do not apply. Existing checklists keep their current items.
tasks.premium: Explorer includes personal tasks, dates and reminders. You can still view, complete, remove and export existing tasks after your plan ends.
tasks.remindersHelp: Choose a time and timezone, then enable reminders on individual tasks with a due date. You will receive one daily summary of unfinished tasks due today or overdue.
tasks.channels: Manage notification channels in the inbox
tasks.reminderSummary: {count, plural, one {You have one task due} other {You have # tasks due}}
tasks.imported: {count, plural, one {One task imported.} other {# tasks imported.}}
tasks.error: Could not save this change. Please try again.
tasks.invalidInput: Check the task details and try again.
tasks.notFound: This task is no longer available.
tasks.unavailable: This checklist is unavailable. You may no longer have access to this chapter.
tasks.conflict: This task changed elsewhere. Review its latest details and try again.
tasks.limit: Use files under 4 MB and keep each list under 500 tasks.
tasks.importLine: Line {line} could not be imported. Check its dates and metadata; no tasks were added.
tasks.subscription: This action requires Explorer or a higher plan.
tasks.offline: Changes will sync when you are back online. Reminders use the last synced version.
tasks.guidance.draft: Read through the chapter and finish any missing passages.
tasks.guidance.consistency: Check that events, characters and world details fit the story. Review any assistant suggestions before marking this done.
tasks.guidance.proofread: Read for spelling, grammar and repeated words. You decide which suggested changes to apply.
tasks.guidance.feedback: Read the beta-reader comments and decide which suggestions to address.
tasks.prompt.timeline: Check chronology, travel times and locations.
tasks.prompt.characters: Check character names, motivations and dialogue.
tasks.prompt.world: Check world rules, clues and unresolved plot points.
tasks.prompt.repetition: Check repeated words and awkward phrasing.
tasks.ai.consistency: Check this chapter for consistency with the rest of the story and encyclopedia. Check chronology, characters, locations, clues and world rules. Quote the passages I should review.
tasks.ai.proofread: Proofread this chapter. Suggest corrections with reasons and quote the passages so I can decide which changes to make.
